en.shortDescription: Open-source identity provider with SSO and MFA
en.longDescription:
Authentik is an open-source identity provider for SSO, OAuth2, SAML, and MFA.

Includes PostgreSQL and Redis with server and worker containers. Secrets use SERVICE_PASSWORD_AUTHENTIK and SERVICE_BASE64_64_AUTHENTIK. Complete the setup wizard on first launch at port 9000.
